newsitem.title: BARBADOS: CRICKET-UNCAPPED REIFER IN WEST INDIES TEST SQUAD.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-UNCAPPED REIFER IN WEST INDIES TEST SQUAD.

text.p: BRIDGETOWN, Barbados, June 8, Reuter - Uncapped middle order batsman Floyd Reifer was named on Sunday in the 13-man West Indies squad for the first test against Sri Lanka starting at the Antigua recreation ground on friday.

Wicketkeeper Courtney Browne, opening batsman Sherwin Campbell and fast bowlers Ian Bishop and Mervyn Dillon, none of whom played in the one-day international in Trinidad on Friday, are also in the squad.

Courtney Walsh (captain), Brian Lara, Stuart Williams, Sherwin Campbell, Shivnarine Chanderpaul, Carl Hooper, Roland Holder, Floyd Reifer, Courtney Browne, Ian Bishop, Curtly Ambrose, Franklyn Rose, Mervyn Dillon.
